text: A sense of inquiry stirs within me. The first space suggests a place of meetings and discourse—perhaps a conference or classroom—a stage set for the exchange of ideas. The second is vibrant and bold, dedicated to research and development, its walls adorned with declarations of curiosity and innovation. I feel curious, as though I am on the brink of discovery, wandering within a temple built for contemplation and progress. The world feels focused, ordered, yet alive with potential.
